title: Pay vendor invoices
summary: Review and pay all outstanding vendor invoices via wire transfer.

parts.title: Pull the outstanding bills
parts.guidance: Export outstanding bills with supplier, invoice number, amount, currency, due date and approval status. Match them to purchase records, credits and recent payments to exclude duplicate, disputed or settled invoices. Resolve missing acceptance or coding with the budget owner. The payment list should show which invoices are ready to pay, which are held and the reason for each hold.

execution.rationale: QuickBooks documents reviewing unpaid bills and linked payments and exporting reports and purchase records. The workflow reconciles those records locally, retaining disputed invoices and budget-owner decisions separately.

parts.title: Check account balance
parts.guidance: Compare each funding account’s available balance with the proposed run, fees, scheduled debits and the cash reserve finance needs to retain. Separate pending receipts and restricted funds from usable cash. If the run would exceed available funds or the agreed cash floor, finance must choose which payments to defer or how to fund the shortfall. Use balances from a stated time.

execution.rationale: Mercury exposes available and current balances for comparing the proposed run with the finance cash floor.

parts.title: Create the payment run for approved bills
parts.guidance: Create the payment run from approved bills, matching each invoice to verified beneficiary details, currency, amount and funding account. Investigate changed bank instructions and duplicate warnings. The designated finance approver authorizes the run and the permitted bank user releases it. Link payment references and actual statuses back to the bills, leaving held or failed transfers visible for reconciliation.

verify.how: Every bill in the run shows paid and the bank debit matches the run total.

execution.rationale: Mercury's send-money and transaction APIs support the approved payments and status readback; the bill references can be reconciled from supplied records.

parts.title: Post the payment summary to the team channel
parts.guidance: Post the payment-run result to the designated private team channel: total released by currency, payment date and items still needing action. The finance owner sends the update using the payment log, with an owner for each exception. Link to controlled records, keep sensitive bank and invoice details in the finance system, and distinguish released transfers from payments still processing.

execution.rationale: Slack chat.postMessage can publish the approved payment summary and controlled record links to the designated channel.

metadata.supportReason: Mercury API supports wire creation. System looks up vendors, verifies balances, executes payments with approval gates.
